items.summary: On August 21, CNBC reported that according to notices published by Tesla and China’s State Administration for Market Regulation, Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) is voluntarily recalling about 3 million vehicles in China over two separate issues: door handles that can fail to open after severe crashes and deficient driver “attention monitoring” systems. items.title: Tesla Stock Has a Huge Catalyst Ahead. Here’s How High It Could Go
items.summary: Tesla is down 23% for the year yet Robotaxi is expanding, Cybercab production has started, and Optimus lines are being installed. Whether those catalysts can close the gap between today's compressed margins and tomorrow's potential defines exactly how far this stock can run.
